Self-hosted map libraries (no CDN needed):
- leaflet 1.9.4                      BSD-2-Clause  (leaflet/LICENSE)
- maplibre-gl 4.7.1                  BSD-3-Clause  (LICENSE.txt)
- @maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet 0.1.4 ISC
Base map tiles are fetched from OpenFreeMap (built on OpenStreetMap data). India's boundary is /static/data/india_official.geojson,
built by tools/build_india_boundary.py from the Survey of India State Map as published by DataMeet (CC BY 4.0).
